name: dir-notification
description: Deliver a teammate-addressed notification into a shared folder, one JSON file per note. Pairs with Folder Sync or S3 Sync: that folder is how the note actually reaches the other person's machine. Only usernames on the roster you declare are accepted; anything else is declined so another backend can take it.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Drop folder
x-meta.help: Absolute path to the shared folder notes are written into (e.g. ~/synced/pc-notes). Supports ~ and $VARS. One subfolder per addressee. Empty means the backend declines everything and stays idle.

x-meta.label: Roster
x-meta.help: Comma-separated usernames this folder can reach (e.g. sam, dana). A note addressed to anybody else is declined so another delivery backend can take it. Empty means the backend declines everything.
